author_inference_review: Numerical comparison against pinned author inference: validation/native-parity.json
benchmark_physics: Shared canonical G1 nominal physics and initialization.

checkpoint_origin.verification: Original raw PyTorch M checkpoint, strict actor/task-embedder loading. No conversion or modified weights; unrelated shared ONNX is not used.

deployment.backend: Original author PyTorch network and export functions on CPU. TensorRT/CUDA equivalence is not implied. Author source and metadata are downloaded at pinned revisions with SHA256 validation.
deployment.mode: Author whole-body control mode 7, reference_forcing=True; original checkpoint and export functions.
deployment.history: Three chronological frames; root-position history starts from the first reference root, other history uses initial proprioception, and last actions start at zero. Six future reference frames at 50 Hz.
deployment.reference: Original author XML and float32 quaternion FK operation order applied to canonical root/joint reference, input-only. No change to dataset or scoring.
deployment.initialization: Benchmark adaptation: substitute the first reference root for measured robot root when initializing history, because robot world position is unavailable under the observation rules. Subsequent author reference forcing is unchanged; simulator reset remains canonical.
deployment.action: Original float32 network PD targets and author gains. Core motor limits, failure and scoring unchanged.
